## Changes
- **Neon: new default accent colour** – the Neon theme now uses an electric blue `#0008ff` for its glow, progress bars, active tab underline and buttons (white text on buttons, 8.5:1 contrast)
- **Readable accent text everywhere** – where the accent colour is used as text (e.g. the links in the *About* card), ArrHub now automatically uses a lighter (dark themes) or darker (light themes) shade of the accent when the original would be hard to read, so links stay at least 4.5:1. Glows, bars and buttons keep the exact accent colour.

If you picked a custom accent colour for Neon, it is kept; the new default applies when the accent is set to *Theme default colour*.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.6.3   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                          # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.6.2...v1.6.3
